LESSON: READING 11.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: NON-FICTION MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials, part of Strand 11 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we read non-fiction materials?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search for digital and print non-fiction materials,

2. read a variety of non-fiction materials,

3. infer the meaning of the words and phrases used in non-fiction materials,

4. skim through the non-fiction material for the main idea,

5. scan the non-fiction material to obtain specific information,

6. prepare a reading log of the reading activities of the non- fiction texts.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search for digital and print non-fiction materials,
2. read a variety of non-fiction materials,
3. infer the meaning of the words and phrases used in non-fiction materials,
4. skim through the non-fiction material for the main idea,
5. scan the non-fiction material to obtain specific information,
6. prepare a reading log of the reading activities of the non- fiction texts.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: It is strengthened as the learner reads a variety of non-fiction materials to inculcate a reading culture.

• Learning to learn: It is instilled as the learner searches for digital and print non-fiction materials using electronic gadgets.

Values:
Responsibility is honed as the learner makes informed choices by recommending to peers suitable non-fiction materials to read.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Life skills, especially self-awareness, is developed as the learner makes own choice of non-fiction materials to interact with.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates extensive reading as a skill which is required in Kiswahili.
